item.title: [@AnthropicAI] Teaching Claude: New research on reducing agentic misalignment
item.description: High-quality documents based on Claude’s constitution, combined with fictional stories that portray an aligned AI, can reduce agentic misalignment by more than a factor of three—despite being unrelated to the evaluation scenario.

item.title: [@OpenAI] Preserving monitorability: Avoiding CoT grading in RL
item.description: Chain of thought monitors are a key layer of defense against AI agent misalignment. To preserve monitorability, we avoid penalizing misaligned reasoning during RL. We found a limited amount of accidental CoT grading which affected released models, and are sharing our analysis.
